title: MSBuild Guard Policy Schema
description: Validation schema for MSBuild Guard policy configurations.

version.description: The policy specification version. Default is 1.

mode.description: Determines the enforcement strategy in build automation. In 'warn' mode, violations are logged as warnings but the build is allowed to proceed.

baselineRequired.description: If true, an approved baseline file must exist in the repository to trust scanning status.

minimumActionBySeverity.description: Maps default actions for findings by risk severity levels. Higher layers cannot weaken these constraints.

rules.description: Specific override actions for individual MSBuild Guard detection rules (e.g. MBG005).

include.description: Glob patterns of files and folders to include in security scans.

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files and folders to ignore during security scans.
